headline: Palace Extends Alternative Government Work to August 20 in NCR and 17 Provinces
seoTitle: Alternative Gov't Work Extended to Aug. 20 | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News evening brief reports that Malacañang extended alternative work arrangements for executive offices in NCR and 17 provinces through August 20.
deck: The extension keeps flexible work arrangements in place as residual flood and transport risks continue.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News evening package reports that Malacañang extended alternative work arrangements for executive government offices in Metro Manila and 17 Luzon provinces for Thursday, August 20.
The package says frontline health, disaster response, law enforcement, fire protection and vital utility services remain subject to on-site operational requirements.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The covered areas mirror the previous day's broad emergency setup, while class suspensions continue to depend on education and local-government decisions.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The extension affects civil-service operations, commuting and access to public offices while authorities work to restore flooded transport routes.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch Palace, agency and LGU advisories for the return to regular on-site operations and any further school suspension announcements.
